#include <bits/stdc++.h>

using namespace std;

typedef long double ld;

void build_binom(ld c[21][21], int n) {
    c[0][0] = 1.0L;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
        c[i][0] = 1.0L;
        for (int j = 1; j <= i; ++j)
            c[i][j] = c[i - 1][j - 1] + c[i - 1][j];
    }
}

void build_masks(int n, const ld p[], ld sum[], int sz[]) {
    int lim = 1 << n;
    for (int mask = 0; mask < lim; ++mask) {
        int cnt = 0;
        ld s = 0.0L;
        for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
            if (mask & (1 << j)) {
                ++cnt;
                s += p[j];
            }
        }
        sz[mask] = cnt;
        sum[mask] = s;
    }
}

void build_coef(ld coef[], const ld c[21][21], int n, int k) {
    for (int i = k - 1; i >= 0; --i) {
        coef[i] = 1.0L - coef[i];
        for (int j = 1; i - j >= 0; ++j)
            coef[i - j] += c[n - 1 - i + j][j] * coef[i];
    }
}

int main() {
    int n, k;
    scanf("%d %d", &n, &k);

    static ld p[20];
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        double x;
        scanf("%lf", &x);
        p[i] = x;
    }

    static ld c[21][21], coef[21], sum[1 << 20];
    static int sz[1 << 20];

    build_binom(c, n);
    build_masks(n, p, sum, sz);
    build_coef(coef, c, n, k);

    int lim = 1 << n;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        ld ans = 0.0L;
        if (p[i] > 0.005) {
            int bit = 1 << i;
            for (int mask = 0; mask < lim; ++mask) {
                if ((mask & bit) != 0) continue;
                if (sz[mask] >= k) continue;
                ans += coef[sz[mask]] / (1.0L - sum[mask]);
            }
        }
        printf("%.12lf ", (double)(p[i] * ans));
    }

    puts("");
    return 0;
}
